title: As Broncos trade for Jaylen Waddle, what's holding up Eagles from trading A.J. Brown? Here are possibilities

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: As Broncos trade for Jaylen Waddle, what's holding up Eagles from trading A.J. Brown? Here are possibilities
sources.description: Execs and talent evaluators still anticipate the Eagles will trade Brown before Week 1, six league sources told Yahoo Sports in conversations over the last week. And they still believe compensation will resemble that of the Waddle deal.
